sheets.noticed: Bold neon title 'An octopus has' and then 'three' in bright cyan, with the hearts circles drawing in. Plain dark background, easy to take in, the cyan word catches the eye.
Three heart circles sit under the title and two of them get GILLS labels and pulse. Still simple and bright, so I stay.
The third heart gets pulled out and the narration says the third pumps. Mild curiosity now, the picture is clearer than the words.
The third heart is labelled BODY and glows. The text is wordy, but the picture is moving toward something.
The two gill hearts fade out and only the body heart stays lit as the narration turns to swimming. Good visual cue, I stay.
The body heart gets a pink X with STOPPED under it. A clear hook, I want to see why.
The stopped heart stays crossed out and the title turns to 'They would rather crawl'. The hook pays off.
The last frames hold 'They would rather crawl' with the heart crossed out. Short and clear, I let it finish.

remembers: An octopus has three hearts: two pump blood through the gills and the third pumps it round the body, and that third heart stops when the octopus swims, which is why they would rather crawl.
